h1: The 6 Best 75-Inch TVs of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 6 best 75-inch TVs of 2026, covering Samsung Mini-LED, Neo QLED, QLED and Crystal UHD plus an LG Nano set.
summary: The Samsung 75-inch Neo QLED QN90F is our top pick for picture tech, with the M70H and M80H Mini-LED sets as strong alternatives. The QN70H is the QLED value choice, the U8000H Crystal UHD is the simple one, and the LG NU85 rounds out the group with Nano technology and AI Sound Pro.
intro: A 75 inch screen exposes weaknesses a 55 inch hides. Backlight type, not the badge on the box, decides whether a big set looks great in a dark room or washed out in a bright one.

We ranked six 75 inch sets from the listing details. We dropped two 85 inch models that appeared in the original pool because they do not match the size in the title. The listings give little beyond panel type and series, so panel tier drives the order.

products.name: Samsung 75-Inch Class Neo QLED 4K QN90F Series
products.verdict: The highest panel tier of the Samsung sets in this ranking.
products.description:
The QN90F is a 75 inch Neo QLED 4K set. The listing places it in the $500+ bracket and names a QLED panel.

It ranks first because Neo QLED is Samsung's step above plain QLED in this lineup. The Mini-LED M-series sets below are close alternatives.

Buy it for a bright living room where a large, premium panel pays off. Caveat: the listing gives no detail beyond the series and panel name.
products.idealFor: Large living rooms that want a premium panel.
products.skipIf: You are on a tight budget.

products.name: Samsung 75-Inch Class M80H Series
products.verdict: A 75 inch Mini-LED in the higher M-series.
products.description:
The M80H is a 75 inch Mini-LED set from Samsung. The listing names the panel type but few other specifics.

It ranks second because the M80H sits above the M70H in series number, so we place it first of the two. It trails the Neo QLED on panel tier.

A fit for buyers who want a Mini-LED panel at this size. Caveat: no price bucket appears on the listing, so check price.
products.idealFor: Mini-LED buyers who want the higher series.
products.skipIf: You want a stated price bracket.

products.name: Samsung 75-Inch Class M70H Series
products.verdict: The Mini-LED M70H lists in the $500+ bracket.
products.description:
The M70H is a 75 inch Mini-LED set, priced in the $500+ bracket on its listing.

It ranks third because it sits one step under the M80H by series number. It beats the QLED sets below on panel technology.

Good for a first Mini-LED large screen. Caveat: little spec detail is shown.

products.name: Samsung 75-Inch Class QN70H Series
products.verdict: A 75 inch QLED set below the Mini-LED models.
products.description:
The QN70H is a 75 inch QLED set. The listing offers the panel name and little else.

It ranks fourth because QLED sits below the Mini-LED sets in this ranking. It is above the Crystal UHD model, which lists no QLED panel.

Suited to bright rooms. Caveat: no price bracket is shown.
products.idealFor: Bright rooms on a mid-range budget.

products.name: Samsung 75-Inch Class U8000H Series Crystal UHD
products.description:
The U8000H is a 75 inch Crystal UHD 4K set. The listing names no QLED or Mini-LED panel.

It ranks fifth because Crystal UHD sits below QLED. It is above the LG NU85 only on brand familiarity in this group.

A fit for casual viewing. Caveat: panel tech is the entry level.

products.name: LG 75-Inch Class Nano AI 4K NU85 Series Smart TV w/AI Sound Pro
products.verdict: The only non-Samsung set, with Nano tech and AI Sound Pro.
products.description:
The NU85 is a 75 inch Nano 4K set from LG with AI Sound Pro. It sits in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks last because Nano is a lower panel tier than QLED or Mini-LED. Its audio feature is the differentiator in this group.

Choose it if you prefer LG. Caveat: no Mini-LED or OLED here.
products.idealFor: LG fans who want a big screen.

methodology.title: Panel technology
methodology.description: Neo QLED, Mini-LED, QLED, Nano and Crystal UHD were ordered by tier.

methodology.description: Within a panel family we ranked by series number, such as M80H above M70H.

methodology.title: Price bracket
methodology.description: Listed buckets were considered, with missing brackets flagged.

whatMatters.detail: Mini-LED and Neo QLED use sophisticated backlights, while Crystal UHD is the entry level. This affects contrast and brightness. Check the title for the panel name.
A 75 inch set suits a seat about 8 to 10 feet away. Sitting closer shows the pixels. Measure before you buy.
A 75 inch TV is wide, so a stand must be as wide as the feet allow. Check stand dimensions and mounting.
Thin big TVs have small speakers. AI Sound Pro helps but a soundbar is better. Look for audio features in the title.
Samsung's M80H sits above M70H. Series numbers give a rough tier. Compare within a brand.

howToChoose.intro: Panel tech matters most in how bright your room is.

cards.label: Mini-LED
cards.text: A backlight of many small LEDs. The M70H and M80H.

cards.label: QLED
cards.text: Quantum dot color, simpler backlight. The QN70H and the Neo QLED QN90F.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to Mini-LED or Neo QLED if the budget allows.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A panel that holds up in ambient light and 4K resolution.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Samsung QN90F is our pick, with the M80H second.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: The room is bright or you watch a lot. The QN90F and M80H justify it.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You watch casually. The U8000H is the simplest set here.

faq.a: Roughly 8 to 10 feet is comfortable for a 4K set at this size.
They do not match the 75 inch promise in the title.

faq.q: Is Mini-LED worth it over QLED?
faq.a: On paper Mini-LED has the more sophisticated backlight, so it is the step up.

faq.q: How do I mount a 75 inch TV?
faq.a: Check the weight and the VESA pattern on the manufacturer's page, and use studs.
Large thin TVs have small speakers, so a soundbar is a common add.

faq.q: Why do some listings lack a price bracket?
faq.a: The data did not include one. Check the listing for the current price.

finalTake: The Samsung QN90F Neo QLED is the safe premium choice. The M80H and M70H give Mini-LED alternatives. If you want to keep things simple, the U8000H Crystal UHD is enough for casual use.
